title: Ship
creator: CrossFit
description: Nine rounds of 7 heavy squat cleans and 8 burpee box jumps to a tall box, for time. Honours Canadian Forces Sgt. Prescott Shipway of 2 PPCLI, killed by a roadside bomb in Kandahar Province in 2008. The 36-inch box is unusually high; drop to 30/24 if in doubt.
